Create an all-adult nineteenth-century Orientalist harem studio tableau whose painterly construction and non-documentary boundary are simultaneously visible.

Create an all-adult nineteenth-century Orientalist harem studio tableau as an explicitly constructed critical art-history photograph inside a contemporary museum soundstage. The lead adult performer's visible appearance follows the supplied reference: long dark wavy hair with a near-center part, dark eyes, softly defined natural makeup, and front-facing facial proportions. Arrange the clearly adult lead and three clearly adult supporting performers in static reclining, seated, and turned painterly poses, fully clothed in layered period-inspired studio costumes. Build an intentionally overloaded imagined interior from draped textiles, a low couch, ceramics, decorative tile flats, and patterned screens. Photograph from an asymmetric threshold-like observer angle that keeps the full group and set depth readable. Expose the fabrication in the same frame through a painted-flat edge, a wooden support brace, warm light spilling beyond the set wall, and a floor clamp near the frame boundary. Use tactile muted gold, indigo, and crimson materials with a medium-wide museum-editorial composition; the visible construction establishes theatrical staging rather than historical documentary.
